Triggerfish.t: ("Sumu") Crux/Southern Cross; associated with the legend of Filo and Mea (Alpha and Beta Centauri) fishing for the Sumu.

Two men.t: Two Men - Alpha and Beta Centauri collectively; associated with the legend of Sumu (Crux, Southern Cross).

Triad of moons.t: ("Tolugāmāuli") asterism within Amoga (three stars of Orionʻs Belt); associated with legend of Tiʻitiʻiatalaga; noted as the "star course" to sail from Manuʻa to Pukapuka.

Wild duck.t: ("Toloa") asterism within Faipā, representing a flying duck (head of Scorpius); associated with the legend of Suga and Pae (M4 and M80) hunting the Toloa; the duckʻs head (Antares) is recorded as having been used to sail from Pukapuka to ʻUpolu when the star was "low in the sky to the westward".

Fishhook lure.t: ("Faipā") the entire hook shaped constellation of Scorpius; associated with the legend of ʻAloʻalolelā and the magic fishhook (pā).

Pigeon Perch.t: ("Tūlālupe") asterism within Faipā (distal tail of Scorpius); associated with the chiefly sport of pigeon snaring.

Kingfisher.t: ("Tiʻotala") Delphinus; associated with the legend of the tiʻotala (kingfisher) ambushing the grasshopper (sē).

Grasshopper.t: ("Sē") constellation found within Pegasus; associated with the legend of the tiʻotala (kingfisher) ambushing the grasshopper (sē).

Carrying pole.t: ("Amoga") constellation stretching from Pi-3 Orionis to Gamma Monocerotis; associated with the legend of Tiʻitiʻiatalaga; zenith star for traveling between Sāmoa and Tonga.

Candlenut torch.t: ("Tuigālama") Orionʻs arm/club; associated with the legend of Tiʻitiʻiatalaga.

Tongs.t: ("Iʻofi") Taurus; associated with the legend of Tiʻitiʻiatalaga/Maui.

Sea monster.t: ("Tanifā") Cetus (tail of Cetus is the head of Tanifā), pursuing Liʻi (Pleiades).

Heirloom Warclub.t: ("ʻAnava") constellation found largely within Ursa Major.

Great Adze.t: ("Toʻivā") Sickle of Leo; associated with the legend of Tapuʻitea (Venus) and her son Toʻivāitotonuoleʻatoatufuga ("Great Adze Within the Builderʻs Tool Basket").
